translations.web: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
translations.bsb: And God said, “Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.”
translations.kjv: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
